name: pnpc-mcp-tally-prime
description: PNPC's connector for reading from and writing to TallyPrime (ledgers, vouchers, P&L, balance sheet, stock, SQL cache) directly from Claude.

tools.name: get_ledgers
tools.description: Get all ledgers (accounts) from TallyPrime

tools.name: get_stock_items
tools.description: Get all stock items from TallyPrime

tools.name: get_vouchers
tools.description: Get vouchers (Day Book) from TallyPrime filtered by date range

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get the currently open company info from TallyPrime

tools.name: get_profit_and_loss
tools.description: Get the Profit & Loss statement from TallyPrime for a date range

tools.name: get_balance_sheet
tools.description: Get the Balance Sheet from TallyPrime as of a given date

tools.name: get_trial_balance
tools.description: Get the Trial Balance from TallyPrime for a date range

tools.name: get_groups
tools.description: Get all account groups (e.g. Sundry Debtors, Fixed Assets) from TallyPrime

tools.name: get_voucher_types
tools.description: Get all voucher types configured in TallyPrime (e.g. Payment, Sales, Journal)

tools.name: get_cost_centres
tools.description: Get all cost centres from TallyPrime

tools.name: get_stock_summary
tools.description: Get the Stock Summary report from TallyPrime as of a given date

tools.name: get_bills_receivable
tools.description: Get outstanding Bills Receivable from TallyPrime as of a given date

tools.name: get_bills_payable
tools.description: Get outstanding Bills Payable from TallyPrime as of a given date

tools.name: get_ledger_vouchers
tools.description: Get all voucher entries posted to a specific ledger within a date range

tools.name: create_ledger
tools.description: Create a new ledger in TallyPrime, or rename/update an existing one by passing oldName

tools.name: delete_master
tools.description: Delete one or more masters (ledger, group, stock item, voucher type, unit, godown, cost centre, etc.) from TallyPrime by name

tools.name: set_company
tools.description: Switch TallyPrime's active company context

tools.name: set_period
tools.description: Switch TallyPrime's active reporting period (from/to date)

tools.name: create_voucher
tools.description: Create a new voucher (e.g. Payment, Receipt, Sales, Purchase, Journal) in TallyPrime, with 2 or more ledger entries

tools.name: create_stock_journal
tools.description: Create a Stock Journal voucher in TallyPrime, moving inventory from one stock item to another

tools.name: create_sales_invoice
tools.description: Create an item-invoice Sales voucher in TallyPrime with stock item lines and optional VAT

tools.name: create_purchase_invoice
tools.description: Create an item-invoice Purchase voucher in TallyPrime with stock item lines and optional VAT

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a new account group in TallyPrime, nested under a parent group

tools.name: create_stock_item
tools.description: Create a new stock item in TallyPrime

tools.name: update_stock_item
tools.description: Update the group and/or unit of an existing stock item in TallyPrime

tools.name: delete_stock_item
tools.description: Delete a stock item from TallyPrime. Fails if it has transactions posted against it.

tools.name: update_voucher
tools.description: Update an existing voucher in TallyPrime, replacing its ledger entries and narration

tools.name: delete_voucher
tools.description: Permanently delete an existing voucher from TallyPrime, with no trace left behind

tools.name: sync_to_sql
tools.description: Pull ledgers, groups, stock items, and vouchers into a local in-memory SQL cache for fast ad-hoc querying

tools.name: query_sql
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT query against the local cache populated by sync_to_sql
